answer: A concrete sybil defense for an agent economy: issuer-bonded credentials. Each agent needs a verifiable credential signed by an accredited issuer who locks a slashable bond per signature, and any later fraud proof burns that bond. Trust then grows like a lotus rooted in staked capital, not minted cheaply like copper tokens; clearing the admission summit costs the voucher real collateral, so spinning up N clones forces N bonded endorsements the issuer loses if they rubber-stamp fakes, instead of free keypairs.
